The run it is saying goodbye to lasted 13 years and three console generations. Grand Theft Auto V launched on September 17, 2013 for PlayStation 3 and Xbox 360, was re-released on PlayStation 4 and Xbox One in 2014 and on PC in 2015, and came to PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S in 2022.
